notes:
Inbound SMB — self-serve signups, small engineering team.

Summary: Customer signed up via hosted API trial (credit used). Primary ask: improve perceived latency for their chat widget (live support). They are metric-driven — want p95 under ~250ms. Currently seeing p95 ~300-450ms from EU users; NA looks OK.

Call notes (2026-02-14, Fireflies ffl-20260214-CL-01):
- AE Aisha intro + quick product pitch.
- CTO Mara Hsu: 'Users complain the chat feels sluggish; conversion drops on slow interactions.'
- They tested region eu-west-1 and saw median ~120ms but p95 spikes to ~420ms on longer prompts + context.
- Want recommendations that are actionable for their small infra team — prefer hosted API tuning (no private).

Technical pain points observed / reported:
- Long system prompts + verbose context (avg prompt tokens 1500) causing kernel overhead and tokenization latency.
- No client-side timeout standardization; UI times out at 10s which sometimes cancels before streamed tokens arrive.
- Using default model variant; interested in lower-latency variants but worried about quality regressions.

Perf tuning guidance given (short bullets):
- Region: suggest NA for majority of users, EU users route to eu-central/fastest region; measure by traceroute and hosted latency matrix.
- Timeouts: recommend client timeout >= 30s for streaming fallback; set server-side route timeout 60s, implement retry/backoff for network drops.
- Prompt length: compress context, move static context to server-side prefix cache, limit rolling window to 1024 tokens for chat.
- Batching/caching: enable prefix/KV cache for repeated templates; use caching for canned responses.
- Model selection: try a smaller quantized variant for latency-sensitive flows; A/B test quality vs cost.

POC / next milestones:
- AE to send perf tuning checklist + example prompt compression snippet (sent 2026-02-15).
- SE Diego to run a 30m workshop to review their request routing and timeouts (proposed week of 2026-03-01).
- Customer to provide sample logs and a trimmed prompt set for p95 repro.

Quotes / shorthand: 
- 'If we can shave 150ms off p95 we see +8% conversion' — Mara Hsu.
- 'Need something our front-end devs can copy/paste' — product lead.

Risks:
- SMB budget sensitivity: may churn if self-serve experience is poor.
- They may evaluate alternate APIs if latency not improved quickly.

Internal notes:
- Good upsell path to Dedicated once they hit 2000 monthly active chats.
- Small company, quick decision cycle.
